chunks: He said: 'Did I not tell you that you will not be able to bear with me with patience?'
ai.seo_question: What did Allah say to Moses regarding his patience with Al-Khidr?
ai.summary: This verse marks the pivotal moment where Allah reminds Moses of His prior warning regarding the limits of human perception when confronted with divine mysteries. In Shia exegesis, this highlights the distinction between *'ilm al-yaqin* (knowledge of certainty) and *'ayn al-yaqin* (eye of certainty), emphasizing that Moses, despite his prophethood, could not grasp the hidden (*batin*) wisdom behind Khidr's seemingly erratic actions without divine revelation.
